title: Mouse without borders is instable
summary: The original report is too sparse to identify one defect, while the follow-up adds several distinct disconnect, reload, tray, and shortcut symptoms across two computers. The attached reports are useful, but the issue needs a structured reproduction matrix before design work can be safely scoped.

status.label: needs information
status.detail: Request a structured two-machine reproduction with exact Mouse Without Borders settings, network topology, timestamps, connection state on both endpoints, and which recovery actions succeed or fail.

judgment.rationale: The original report is too sparse to identify one defect, while the follow-up adds several distinct disconnect, reload, tray, and shortcut symptoms across two computers. The attached reports are useful, but the issue needs a structured reproduction matrix before design work can be safely scoped.
evidence: The original report only states that the mouse eventually stops moving to the other computer.
The follow-up describes spontaneous disconnects, failure to reconnect, asymmetric connection indicators, ineffective tray reload behavior, and a non-working reload shortcut.
The follow-up covers Windows 11 25H2 and Windows 10 22H2 with PowerToys 0.100.2 on both machines.
Bug reports for both computers are attached.
The issue has no assignee and no linked fix visible in the discussion.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a structured two-machine reproduction with exact Mouse Without Borders settings, network topology, timestamps, connection state on both endpoints, and which recovery actions succeed or fail.

comment.body: Please provide a structured reproduction for both computers: the exact PowerToys version, Windows version/build, Mouse Without Borders device names and connection settings, network topology, and whether both machines are on the same subnet. For one failure, record the approximate UTC/local time, which computer had the keyboard and mouse, the connection indicators shown on each computer, and whether the failure followed sleep, network changes, locking, or restarting PowerToys. Please also test the tray reload command and reload shortcut separately, noting the exact result of each, and attach fresh bug reports from both machines generated immediately after the same failure.
